evidence.title: NetBird - Open Source Zero Trust Networking
GitHub - netbirdio/netbird: NetBird securely connects people, machines and AI agents across any network with one identity-based Zero Trust platform. Powered by peer-to-peer WireGuard® · GitHub

name: NetBird
summary: Open-source, WireGuard-based overlay network and Zero Trust access platform with SSO, MFA and access policies.
description: An open-source networking platform that connects devices peer-to-peer over WireGuard and adds identity-based Zero Trust access control: SSO and MFA, granular group policies, device posture checks, private DNS, network routes, SSH and activity logging. Runs as a managed cloud or self-hosted, with agents for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android and more.
contains: Open-source WireGuard-based overlay network with Zero Trust access control
Pricing: free up to 5 users, Team €6 and Business €12 per user/month, Enterprise custom
Identity-based policies with SSO, MFA and SCIM provisioning
Device posture checks with MDM and EDR integrations
Self-hosting quickstart script or managed cloud service
Agents for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, FreeBSD and more
Terraform provider, Ansible collection and public API
BSD-3-Clause license, with the management, signal and relay directories under AGPLv3
